_doc: Optional real audio files. Put .mp3/.ogg/.wav files in this folder and list them here as "name": "file". A listed file replaces the synthesised sound of the same name; anything not listed keeps the synth version. Names: success soundboard = register, coin, jingle; fail soundboard = siren, cuffs; also click, alarm, freeze, vault, tick, win; and music (a seamless loop whose pitch and tempo rise with the game). Example: "sounds": { "register": "cash-register.mp3", "music": "heist-loop.ogg" }
